newsitem.title: USA: Duff rates Hidroelectrica Piedra note offering.
newsitem.headline: Duff rates Hidroelectrica Piedra note offering.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it assigned a double-B rating to Hidroelectrica Piedra del Aguila SA's offering of five-year, single maturity US$100 million Euro medium-term notes.
The notes were to be issued under the company's US$300 million Euro medium-term note program.

Hidroelectrica Piedra is an Argentine hydroelectric generating company located about 1,200 kilometers southwest of Buenos Aires. The company supplies electricity primarily to the spot market in Argentina's National Interconnected System.

Duff said over the next several years, market prices for electricity in Argentina are expected to soften as a result of excess generating capacity in the system, the addition of several low marginal cost natural gas-fired units and low natural gas prices.
Despite expected weakening in electricity prices, Hidroelectrica Piedra's cash flow should be sufficient to satisfactorily meet its debt service obligations, Duff said.
Hidroneuquen is a 59 percent owner of Hidroelectrica Piedra.
